title: HMS-6: Appointment Scheduling Feature Implementation
notes: Target branch is feature/docs-sync, not main — this is the repository's actual default branch; no main branch exists in madhavi638/claude-capstone.

Repository already contained an unrelated capstone project (STLC-Capstone, ticket SC-1) on feature/docs-sync. feature/HMS-6 was created as a new root (orphan) branch, then merged with feature/docs-sync using --allow-unrelated-histories solely to give GitHub a common ancestor for the PR diff — this added the existing STLC content into the HMS-6 branch's history but did not modify any of it.

env/git.env (GITHUB_USERNAME, GITHUB_TOKEN, GITHUB_REPO) was used in place of the orchestrator spec's expected env/github.env (GITHUB_USERNAME, GITHUB_OWNER, GITHUB_REPOSITORY, GITHUB_BASE_BRANCH, GITHUB_TOKEN) — GITHUB_USERNAME doubled as owner, GITHUB_REPO as repository name, and the base branch was taken from the repo's actual default branch since GITHUB_BASE_BRANCH was not supplied.
